text: No, I don't want to keep it as is. And I don't want the red one either. Like I said, I want the blue one with 20 hours battery life and water resistance. Is that really the only one? Can you check again? I don't believe that's true.
zh: 不，我不想保持现状。我也不想要红色的那个。就像我说的，我想要那个蓝色、电池续航20小时、防水的。那真的是唯一一个吗？你能再检查一下吗？我不相信那是真的。
